description:
ProviPanda ist ein wachsendes HR-Tech-Startup und mittlerweile die größte Sales-Job-App im DACH-Raum. Mit einem Team aus 15 Mitarbeitenden arbeiten wir daran, den Sales-HR-Markt zu revolutionieren und neu zu denken.
Als Customer Success Manager bist du die zentrale Anlaufstelle für unsere über 200 aktiven Kunden im Tagesgeschäft. Du sorgst dafür, dass sie zufrieden sind, langfristig bei uns bleiben und mit uns wachsen.
Deine Aufgaben
Du führst Onboardings und regelmäßige Check-ins durch und kennst deine Kunden wirklich

Du hilfst bei allen Kundenproblemen, egal ob Support oder Success, und bleibst dran, bis sie gelöst sind

Du bist erste Ansprechperson für alle Kundenthemen außerhalb von Sales

Du übernimmst Eskalationen und behältst auch bei schwierigen Kunden einen kühlen Kopf

Du entscheidest eigenständig bei Refunds, Kulanzfällen und Zahlungsthemen (Stripe)

Du bindest Kunden langfristig und baust gemeinsam mit dem Sales-Team Accounts aus

Du erkennst Upsell-Potenzial im Kundengespräch und gibst es gezielt weiter

Das bringst du mit
Du bist kundenorientiert, lösungsorientiert und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Probleme deiner Kunden

Du hast eine hohe Stressresilienz und bleibst auch in hektischen Phasen souverän

Du hast Fingerspitzengefühl im Umgang mit Menschen, gerade wenn es mal schwierig wird

Du erkennst echtes Potenzial und unterscheidest A-Kunden von C-Kunden, ohne dir etwas vormachen zu lassen

title: Lead Social Media & Account Management (m/w/d) - Vollzeit - Hybrid
summary: Wer wir sind Die HEBU GmbH ist eine Beteiligungsgesellschaft mit Sitz in Leipzig. Wir finanzieren Unternehmen nicht nur, sondern begleiten sie aktiv in Management und Business Development. Für eine…
description:
Wer wir sind
Die HEBU GmbH ist eine Beteiligungsgesellschaft mit Sitz in Leipzig. Wir finanzieren Unternehmen nicht nur, sondern begleiten sie aktiv in Management und Business Development.
Für eine Agentur aus unserem Portfolio suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die den Bereich Social Media operativ verantwortet. Die Agentur ist seit über 8 Jahren am Markt und betreut Kunden aus den unterschiedlichsten Branchen. Jetzt stellen wir den Bereich Social Media neu auf und wollen ihn gezielt ausbauen.
Das heißt für dich: kein Verwalten eines fertigen Systems, sondern echte Gestaltung. Du entscheidest mit über Angebote, Preise, Prozesse und darüber, mit welchen Freelancern wir arbeiten - mit der Rückendeckung eines Gesellschafters, der Wachstum will.
Aufgaben
Key Account Management - Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und entwickelst bestehende Kunden weiter

Vertrieb & Angebote - Du führst Vertriebsgespräche mit Interessent:innen, erstellst Angebote und kalkulierst Preise eigenverantwortlich (keine Kaltakquise)

Projektsteuerung - Du planst und steuerst Social-Media-Projekte von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung - Zeit, Budget und Qualität hast du im Blick

Freelancer-Management - Du baust einen Pool aus mehreren Freelancer:innen auf, wählst sie aus, briefst sie und steuerst sie fachlich

Qualitätssicherung - Du stellst sicher, dass alles, was rausgeht, strategisch sitzt und handwerklich überzeugt

Du weißt, warum organischer Content zuerst kommt und Ads erst danach funktionieren.
Du schneidest deine Videos selbst und produzierst mit dem Smartphone.

Partnerschaften über 12 Monate. Du baust eine Brand auf und springst nicht von Kampagne zu Kampagne.

summary: Unser Kunde ist ein schnell wachsender europäischer Innovator im Bereich Baby-Mobilität und Lifestyle-Produkte. Das Unternehmen entwickelt und produziert preisgekrönte Kinderwagen, Buggys und…
description:
Unser Kunde ist ein schnell wachsender europäischer Innovator im Bereich Baby-Mobilität und Lifestyle-Produkte. Das Unternehmen entwickelt und produziert preisgekrönte Kinderwagen, Buggys und Babyausstattung, die Stil, Sicherheit und Funktionalität verbinden und denen Tausende Eltern weltweit vertrauen.
Hier werden mutige Ideen zu echten Produkten, die man auf den Straßen in Europa, Asien und darüber hinaus sieht. Mit einer starken internationalen Präsenz und einem wachsenden Vertriebsnetz verfolgt das Unternehmen ein klares Ziel: das Elternsein einfacher, smarter und stilvoller zu machen.
Für Sie bedeutet das die Chance, Teil eines dynamischen, stark wachsenden Umfelds zu werden, in dem Ihre Vertriebsexpertise wirklich zählt. Hier werden Ergebnisse anerkannt, Eigeninitiative wird belohnt, und Karrieren wachsen mit dem globalen Erfolg des Unternehmens.
Wir suchen
Für das Team unseres Kunden suchen wir eine dynamische und motivierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Vertriebsorientierung und einem klaren Fokus auf Ergebnisse, die die Position als Business Development Manager (DACH) übernimmt.
In dieser Position sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, das Geschäftswachstum voranzutreiben und die Präsenz der Marke in DACH auszubauen. Dabei entwickeln und pflegen Sie starke und langfristige Beziehungen zu Kunden und Partnern.
Ihre Hauptaufgaben
Ausbau, Entwicklung und Betreuung des Kundenportfolios im Retail-Kanal zur Stärkung der Positionierung und Präsenz der Marke.

Du bist der Brückenkopf zur Datenschutzbeauftragten (DPO) und zum CISO in UK und sorgst dafür, dass DSGVO und Kundenanforderungen pragmatisch und effizient umgesetzt werden. 1. Datenschutzkoordination
Pflege von Verarbeitungsverzeichnis, TOM-Dokumentation, Löschkonzepten, Datenschutzhinweisen und Einwilligungsprozessen

Prüfung von Auftragsverarbeitungsverträgen sowie neuen Tools und Dienstleistern

Bearbeitung von Betroffenenanfragen, Vorbereitung von Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen

Behandlung von Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsvorfällen inkl. Meldeprozessen

Steuerung technischer und organisatorischer Sicherheitsmaßnahmen mit IT-Abteilung und UK-Sicherheitsteam, inkl. Notfallvorsorge und Incident Response

description:
About TACTILIA
At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.
This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now.
Your work will contribute to turning advanced robotics into reliable, manufacturable and deployable technology for real-world industrial applications.

Don't see the right role?
Great people don't always fit neatly into an existing job description. If you're excited about what we're building but haven't found a suitable opening, we'd still love to hear from you!
We're always interested in meeting people who want to help shape the future of robotics and Physical AI, whether your expertise lies in:
Engineering & Robotics: Mechanical engineering, electronics, actuators, embedded systems, controls, robotics and system integration.

Software & AI: Robotics software, machine learning, perception, motion planning and software development.

Product & Industrialisation: Product development, testing, manufacturing, quality, reliability and technical operations.

description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for our first dedicated Senior Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs and payment flows. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks.

What you will do:
Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows.

Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction.

Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche. Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden. Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern.
Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen.

description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.

In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries.

Engineered for performance, our stack leverages PyTorch for model training, NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference. description:
Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day.

About HIVED 📦
At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.
Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.
A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.
Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.
Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

description:
About Kog
At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents.
Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act.
Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs.
We've developed several technologies to make this possible:
Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs.

KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency.

Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading.

Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach.

Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution.
Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released.
Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today.
These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark…

title: Manager Cloud Architect - Paris
summary: Présentation du poste :  Concevoir une architecture d’IA, c’est engager une entreprise pour plusieurs années : l’emplacement des données, la gestion des accès, la manière dont un agent passe en…
description:
Présentation du poste :

Concevoir une architecture d’IA, c’est engager une entreprise pour plusieurs années : l’emplacement des données, la gestion des accès, la manière dont un agent passe en production sous le regard des équipes de sécurité. Ces choix structurants, vous les construisez avec nos clients.

Tout le reste, ce sont les ambitions fonctionnelles et techniques du client, son cadre réglementaire, son budget, les compétences qu'il peut réellement mobiliser en interne, la gouvernance qu'il veut installer, et un écosystème d'éditeurs qui gravite autour de lui. Votre rôle est de trouver le point d'équilibre entre ces forces, de le faire accepter, puis de le réajuster dès que l'une d'elles bouge.

Votre point de départ n’est pas la technologie, mais l’ambition métier. Vous la traduisez en une plateforme data ou agentique pensée pour s’intégrer au système d’information existant, avec son histoire, ses contraintes et ses équipes. Votre rôle ne s’arrête pas à la validation du schéma cible : vous accompagnez les équipes de delivery jusqu’à la mise en production.

À titre d’exemple, chez l’un de nos clients, chaque nouvel agent repose désormais sur une plateforme commune qui gère nativement les droits d’accès, le monitoring et les coûts. Chaque cas d’usage s’appuie ainsi sur les fondations posées pour les précédents.

Ce poste s’adresse à vous si vous aimez embrasser un système dans son ensemble, prendre les décisions qui engagent et en expliquer les raisons.

description:
About Sonio

Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents.

Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path.

Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence.

About the role

We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineering intern to join our Platform team (DevOps, Data and Staff Engineers), which runs the infrastructure behind our SaaS platform. As the platform grows, so do our internal operational requests. Your mission will be to find out how far AI agents can take this RUN work off our plate, without giving up control.

Your main mission will be to:

Build an AI agent that turns internal infrastructure requests (provisioning a new service, managing AWS resources and access, environment…

description:
About Inbolt
Deploying an industrial robot still takes months of integration and programming, and the moment a part, a process, or a position changes, it starts over. Inbolt makes it take minutes.
Our generalist vision model gives robots the ability to see, think, and adapt in real time, so any robot can master any process, part, or station. Set up from a CAD model in minutes and compatible with FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Comau, and Universal Robots, Inbolt runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM, Bosch and more, with 200+ systems live across 100+ factories on three continents.
We're a team based in Paris, Detroit and Japan, and we're growing fast. Here's the role:
As our Associate Product Manager Intern, you will sit at the crossroads of our customers, our sales team and our engineers. Working alongside our Product Lead, you will make sure that what we build answers real business needs: you will gather what customers and the field are telling us, translate it into clear product priorities and specs, and give Sales and Ops the material they need to sell and deploy Inbolt with confidence. In short, your mission is to turn the work of our 20 engineers into value our customers understand and buy.

🎯 Responsibilities
Collect and structure customer feedback, feature requests and field issues coming from Sales, Ops and client sites, and turn them into clear, prioritized specs the engineering team can act on.

summary: Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) Founding Strategy & Operations !  Missions  🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui…
description:
Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) Founding Strategy & Operations !

Missions

🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots
En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH :
ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids ;

c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle.

Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies.
C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché, au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME.…

We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. description:
Who You’ll Work With
As a Layer1 software engineer, you will get to work on software that manages the physical layer, where packets meet the outside world. Stable and reliable physical connectivity is critical for any network and that is your challenge. You will get to write control software that brings to life everything from the ubiquitous 1GBASE-T connectors to 400G long reach optics that provide fiber connectivity across continents. Your software will need to work across a wide variety of forwarding engines, connectors and interface chips called gearboxes, which allow our hardware platforms to support diverse physical connectivity options within a product family. You will build instrumentation and telemetry tools that track physical link health parameters reported by the Layer1 components and enable operators to monitor and troubleshoot their links effectively. You will also work closely with our Optics teams to define standards for new media and bring them to market.
Arista Software Engineering roles demand a strong and broad software engineering background. While the primary focus area for this role is Layer1 software, the role will cover all aspects of software development spanning the addition of new features, debugging problems and fine tuning code for scalability and performance. You will own your projects from definition to deployment and customer interactions, and you will be responsible for the quality of everything you deliver.

When the Tarr Steps, a footbridge assembled of heavy stones in Exmoor National Park in England, washed away in a flood in 1942, the Royal Engineers rebuilt it. Then it washed away again in 1952. So the Royal Engineers heaved in more stones: on and on, like a Sisyphean lesson in absurdity.
Of course, they do this because the Tarr Steps are a historical monument, believed to be built during the Bronze Age. Modern bridge building looks a lot different and generally requires less upkeep. While we appreciate the charm of ancient things, Mercury is engineering the future of banking*. "Quaint" and "archaic" are not values we seek in our systems. Rebooting a tumbling server and hoping a flood of requests doesn't wash it away can be an emergency tactic, but we actively seek out durable solutions over monotonous ops work. You'll bring this ethos and teach others how to live it too.

About Us:

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.
The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. title: Senior Scrum master
summary: Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken. AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter.…
description:
Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken.
AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt.
Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We bouwen aan moderne software, slimme dataplatformen en agentic oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd kijken we hoe AI onze eigen manier van werken verandert.
Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen,  wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

Jouw rol
Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties.
Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor de organisatie, developers, product owners en stakeholders en weet wanneer je moet coachen, uitdagen of juist ruimte moet geven.
Maar je kijkt ook vooruit.
Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? En hoe zorg je dat teams nieuwe technologie omarmen zonder hun focus op mensen en resultaat te verliezen?

description:
Senior Business Analist – Rechtshulp (Synergy/Dynamics)
Assen | 38 uur | Schaal 10
Het mooie van werken bij Univé
Wil jij een belangrijke rol spelen in de digitale vernieuwing van onze juridische dienstverlening? Ben jij een ervaren businessanalist die complexe processen doorgrondt, inhoudelijk richting geeft en graag zelf met beide benen in de praktijk staat?
Binnen de waardestroom Juridisch Advies werken we aan de migratie van Synergy naar Microsoft Dynamics. Een uitdagende verandering waarbij niet alleen technologie, maar vooral onze bedrijfsprocessen en de dienstverlening aan onze leden centraal staan.
Als Senior Business Analist krijg jij de ruimte om deze verandering inhoudelijk vorm te geven. Je voert zelfstandig complexe analyses uit, begeleidt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat businessbehoeften worden vertaald naar toekomstbestendige oplossingen.
Wie ben jij?
Je bent een ervaren businessanalist die overzicht houdt in complexe verandertrajecten. Je begrijpt hoe bedrijfsprocessen, informatievoorziening en IT-systemen samenhangen en weet deze kennis te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen.
Je bent inhoudelijk sterk, maar vindt het minstens zo belangrijk om collega's verder te helpen.
Je wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen. Je neemt initiatief, stelt kritische vragen en durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen.
Wat breng je mee?
Aantoonbare ervaring met complexe business- en procesanalyses binnen een IT-omgeving.

title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support
summary: Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en…
description:
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. 

Wie ben jij
Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.

Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.

Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.

Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale…

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

description:
About us
At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

The role
Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.

You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the…

About Claims
AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.
We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.
The team
Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.
Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge—you will often be "the PM."

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly.

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge —you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.
